In the name of JHUNAL, those who have committed abominations shall be sealed in this land. May no one be enchanted by their curse.
Sinful Hamah and her abominations are hereby hidden away. Until the people forget their names, until the people forget their forms.

O Anem, daughter of mercy,
heal even the lowly as they walk the mountains,
lest they be deceived by the beast.

O Zuzu, daughter of silence,
hide all the secrets in your mouth,
lest the people find the beast.

O Hela, daughter of the spinner,
I entrust you with a drop taken from the beast.
Hide it in the forest's depths so that none may be enchanted by it.

O Aradia, daughter of the sleepless,
watch over the dragon's fire sealing this hole,
lest someone crawl through the forest on a moonlit night.

O Hamah, daughter of song,
drown out the whispers of the beast with your voice,
lest it speak to our dreams.

The mystic of long-lost Nede arts made an offering of her flesh, her heart, and even her very soul. The wind swept her soul away, her heart sank to the bottom of the deep sea, and all that was left was flesh and blood, warm even in death. Whoever sheds blood must bleed themself. That, at least, is atonement.

It is said that a golden dragon sleeps in the mountains of Atmora. Its fire once lit Hinnom, illuminating the dark depths of the waters there. When the deep blew out the light, she found Namira in that darkness. And there, she received a mission to hide the Radiance. No matter how much the slumbering God may dream of a sleeping heart, this heart will never sleep. She knew then this was the beginning of Radiance.

Once, she heard the Beast. She sang with the Beast on moonlit nights and danced to the music of the Tree Spirit. I wonder, when did the secret hidden in the Beast's decisive voice rob her of her sleep? In the end, she covered her ears and chose tranquility. There, at the Spring of Kyne, the source of its waters, this is tranquility. No one's song can be heard there, not even Y'ffre's, for its waters rise up and fill all.

The Witch of Wire and Strings traveled back in time. She gave eyes to the giant's daughter, and they led her to the secret of all colors. When her master was imprisoned in the depths of Saarthal, the Witch's apprentice found Vaermina's guidance at the cliffs of nightmares and traveled to the world of dreams. From there, she kept whispering to sleeping minds. Her voice still lingers deep in my heart. Water is memory, the sea is a mystery.

Parched and dried up at the end, and yet she lacks all mercy. But the body Anem created for her still defies the providence of Kyne, refusing to rot. As if to show her transgression her blood is heavier than anything, sticking to nothing without dissolving in it, as if to show her attachment to Love. And though her soul is burdened by corruption and debauchery, her blood and flesh remain untainted and will become the perfumed oil for the godly.
The mortal shepherd bound both ends of Time together, creating a recursion. Now all is merely temporary.
BBBux's molt sprang up in the snows of Atmora but froze there fruitlessly. Bughut craved wings, formed an image of a family steeped in nostalgia and waited for the one carrying the dragon blood.

Yelem foresaw the future through his nightmares and submerged himself endlessly in the repeating stream of time. But no matter how much he devoured himself on the Cannibal Hill, the Dream would never be his.

The body the knowledgeable BBBux awakened was already empty. When a third of the ghosts sang in empty vessels, a twisted mother was born from the memories of flesh. The lost Ghost Choir. Transformation of the mnemic causes reassignment of the nymic. And so, the application of digital codes to memory brings about change.

The white-scaled Argonian named Milk Drinker observed Jubal, witnessed his marriage, and received an epiphany. He imitated the flowering, conceived the milk tree, and finally beheaded himself. This was a small rebellion against the Hist.
The knowledgeable BBBux was severed from Herma-Mora and awakened to insanity. He molts over and over again and forever craves the winter sleep.
The kind, loyal Oohoo'Laf is a writing finger of Herma-Mora. In his guise of Oohoo'Laf he is faceless, however, and eternally jealous and contemptuous of mortals.
The name of the branch was taken by Oohoo'Laf, and it forgot even its form. And so, the nameless was assigned the nearest shape.

O Star Orphan, awaken and fall in love with the existence. O Blue Star, commit all the things to memory and awake everyone to sanity. Recall the memory of solemn rites in all who perform them, and make them never forget. 
If you could sing in the calm Spring, would we hear this song?
BBBux knew nothing yet. A mortal mind, transformation a memory can bring. Daedra's mind collapsed easily after knowing death.
Nerevarine never saw the Dragon's tail. The Loveletter already arrived. And so, Nerevarine returned to their journey in relief. This is now merely a memory, sinking into the depths of the sea.
Hatred is peace. I AM AND YOU ARE ALL ME. The Doom Drum keeps on beating, still repeating Lorkhan's failure. This failure has been predestined.

The brass giant marches to victory. As the Dwemer fled from their own existence, so the brass giant denies everything. The magic word is MAYBE. This is why the brass giant affirms it in the end. There is no Wheel and no Lull beyond that.
The winds of Kyne did not carry Laza's soul to the Spring. Nevertheless, his soul ran through blood like a bloodhound, driving others to the Spring.
